sandbox.name: Podman
sandbox.detail: Podman 3.4.4 ready (rootless; kernel 6.8.0-1070-azure), needed for every Session and every axocoatl run

sandbox.name: Podman version
sandbox.detail: Podman 3.4.4 is too old: Axocoatl runs need Podman 4.3 or later (4.9 tested). Ubuntu 22.04 ships Podman 3.4.4; use Ubuntu 24.04 or newer
sandbox.fix: Install Podman 4.9 or later from your distribution (Ubuntu 24.04 or newer, Debian 13, Fedora)

sandbox.name: Resource caps
sandbox.detail: rootless Podman can use the cgroup controllers [memory, pids], so Session containers run without their CPU (2 CPUs, cgroup controller cpu) cap (sandbox.require_resource_limits: true refuses to start them instead)
sandbox.fix: sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d && printf '[Service]\nDelegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf && sudo systemctl daemon-reload, then log out and back in
